task.title: Register real POST scheduling for the existing mail queue
task.input: Existing mail-queue handler/worker, mail gate, and M5 JobState; retain the old mail-status protocol.
task.output: Real per-minute cron for existing POST /api/admin/cron/mail-queue and a corresponding fixed JobState summary.
task.accept: 1) Caller/wiring point: deploy/cron.nbshiyan sends a per-minute POST to old mail-queue -> existing mail gate/Bearer -> worker. After restart, controlled SMTP actually consumes committed mail. Keep stale/sent/failed/deferred/dropped fields unchanged and do not trigger through GET prefetch (E-94). 2) Compatible GET/POST entries share leases/JobState summaries. HTTP timeouts do not automatically replay or change methods to probe. Unknown SMTP outcomes preserve old unknown_delivery semantics. Unauthorized/disabled calls send no mail, and failure never claims SENT (E-35, E-41).
